settings.federation.visibility.title: Visibility
settings.federation.visibility.subtitle: Control how other stations can discover this account.
settings.federation.visibility.label: Discoverable as
settings.federation.visibility.tooltip: Visibility is enforced at the DHT layer. Hidden writes a tombstone; By handle keeps you reachable only to people who already know your handle; Indexed opts you into the future cross-station directory.
settings.federation.visibility.hidden.hi: Withdraw your locator. Other stations cannot resolve your handle until you flip back.
settings.federation.visibility.by_handle: Reachable only to people who already know @user@station. Default for new accounts.
settings.federation.visibility.indexed.h: Allow inclusion in cross-station directory searches (Phase F). Behaves like By handle today, but the consent is recorded.

settings.general.agentDefaultsDescriptio: New Agents inherit the Provider, model, and effort. Each Agent can override them after creation.
